note: Inyo NF campground on Big Pine Creek under Jeffrey pines and cottonwoods, off Glacier Lodge Rd about 9 mi west of Big Pine; the creek is stocked with trout. The Big Pine Creek trail into the John Muir Wilderness starts up the road. --Claude
